checks.descripcion: app tiene en linea un runner de proyecto con la etiqueta docker y ejecutor kubernetes
checks.graphql: query($fullPath: ID!){ project(fullPath: $fullPath){ runners(type: PROJECT_TYPE){ nodes{ tagList paused managers{ nodes{ executorName status } } } } } }
checks.jq: [.data.project.runners.nodes[] | select((.tagList | index("docker")) and (.paused | not)) | .managers.nodes[] | select(.executorName == "kubernetes" and .status == "ONLINE")] | length >= 1

checks.descripcion: El runner de Kubernetes corre la version fijada del runner, 19.2.2
checks.graphql: query($fullPath: ID!){ project(fullPath: $fullPath){ runners(type: PROJECT_TYPE){ nodes{ managers{ nodes{ executorName version } } } } } }

checks.descripcion: docker-app sigue registrado, en pausa, como vuelta atras
checks.graphql: query($fullPath: ID!){ project(fullPath: $fullPath){ runners(type: PROJECT_TYPE){ nodes{ tagList paused managers{ nodes{ executorName } } } } } }
checks.jq: [.data.project.runners.nodes[] | select((.tagList | index("docker")) and any(.managers.nodes[]; .executorName == "docker"))] | length >= 1 and all(.paused)

checks.descripcion: Solo un runner de app sin pausar tiene la etiqueta docker
checks.graphql: query($fullPath: ID!){ project(fullPath: $fullPath){ runners(type: PROJECT_TYPE){ nodes{ tagList paused } } } }

checks.descripcion: El runner dind de la Semana 15 sigue en linea y sin pausar
El ultimo pipeline de main en verde construyo en el runner de Kubernetes
checks.graphql: query($fullPath: ID!){ project(fullPath: $fullPath){ pipelines(ref: "main", status: SUCCESS, first: 1){ nodes{ jobs{ nodes{ name runner{ managers{ nodes{ executorName } } } } } } } } }

checks.descripcion: app versiona docs/linea-base-s16.json con tres pipelines antes y tres despues
checks.jq: .content != null and (.content | @base64d | fromjson | (.antes.pipelines | length) >= 3 and (.despues.pipelines | length) >= 3)

checks.descripcion: La linea base mide docker-app antes y el runner de Kubernetes despues
checks.jq: .content != null and (.content | @base64d | fromjson | all(.antes.pipelines[]; .runners | index("docker-app")) and all(.despues.pipelines[]; .runners | index("docker-app") | not))

checks.descripcion: Todos los pipelines de la linea base terminaron en verde
infra/entornos versiona los values de Helm del runner de Kubernetes con la cache en S3
checks.jq: .content != null and (.content | @base64d | test("kubernetes") and test("cache-s3") and test("concurrent"))

checks.descripcion: Los values del runner no contienen ningun token de runner ni claves S3
app versiona docs/finops.md con el coste por minuto y por pipeline
checks.jq: .content != null and (.content | @base64d | test("minuto"; "i") and test("pipeline"; "i") and test("linea-base-s16"))
